text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world quickly, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias. If AI learns from data that contains unfair patterns, it can make biased decisions, for example in hiring or lending. This is why fairness must be a priority—we need systems that treat everyone equally. Privacy is another key issue. AI often uses personal data, so developers must protect people's information and be clear about how it is used. Transparency is also essential. People should understand why an AI makes a certain choice. For this to happen, responsible AI development is necessary. Developers, companies, and governments must work together to create AI that is safe, honest, and beneficial for all.
